# masamune_signin_facebook

**Tag**: ui, security

## 简介

Plugin for signing in with a Facebook account. Basically used with masamune_firebase authentication; requires use of FirebaseAuth.

## 官网

- 主页: https://mathru.net
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/mathrunet/flutter_masamune/tree/master/packages/masamune_signin_facebook
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/masamune_signin_facebook
